'''Korol Tander''' was a male [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who worked as a [[Special Agent/Legends|Special Agent]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Tander was stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], under [[Bureau Chief]] [[Rieekan (SIS)|Rieekan]]. Out of fear that their [[Agent/Legends|agents]] had been compromised, Tander sent an omega alert to their field agents, but only half responded. Tander argued that the unit should abandon their base, but Rieekan refused to move their base and compromise their current operations. During an attack on the [[SIS safe house]], Rieekan was killed and Tander took over as Acting Bureau Chief. He would later achieve the rank of [[Field Operations Director]].

==Personality and traits==
Tander was a competent and dedicated SIS agent, and he put the safety of his entire unit ahead of a single operation.
